config.lumispheric.title: Lumispheric
config.lumispheric.tooltip.enabled: Toggle Lumispheric's custom Overworld sky on or off.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.profile.vanil: Minecraft-inspired pixel style with 48-day seasons and balanced sky effects.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.profile.reali: Smooth KSP-style orbital planet with city lights, swirling cyclones, and a 365-day year.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.profile.perfo: Lighter cloud distance and subtle night effects for higher FPS.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.sunset_intens: Adjusts the warm golden, coral, and rose glow during sunrise and sunset.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.mie_intensity: Controls the soft atmospheric scattering halo around the Sun.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.latitude: Adjusts the apparent path of celestial bodies and polar aurora visibility.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.year_length: Sets how many Minecraft days an astronomical year takes (seasons, constellations, and planetary motion).
config.lumispheric.tooltip.celestial_siz: Changes the size of the Sun and Moon, from 25% to 100% of vanilla.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.star_brightne: Adjusts star brightness at night and in space.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.milky_way_bri: Adjusts the brightness of the Milky Way band.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.cloud_distanc: Extends cloud render distance; lower values reduce that extension.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.reset: Restores the default Vanilla+ settings and 40° N latitude.
config.lumispheric.tooltip.pixelated_sty: Switches between clean Minecraft pixel aesthetics (pixelated Milky Way, auroras, Moon phases, spyglass planets, and voxel orbital world) and smooth realistic rendering with KSP-style cyclones and night city lights.
